menu.name: Placeholder Options
menu.desc: Placeholder till I make this a custom state.

checkbox.name: Shaders
checkbox.desc: If unchecked, disables shaders.\nIt\'s used for some visual effects, and also CPU intensive for weaker PCs

checkbox.name: Advanced Shaders
checkbox.desc: If checked, enables shaders which might be laggy or even might crash your game.

checkbox.name: Hide HUD
checkbox.desc: If checked, hides most HUD elements.

choice.name: Time Bar
choice.desc: What should the Time Bar display?

checkbox.name: Flashing Lights
checkbox.desc: Uncheck this if you're sensitive to flashing lights!

checkbox.name: Screen Shake
checkbox.desc: Uncheck this if you don't want the screen to shake!

checkbox.name: Camera Zooms
checkbox.desc: If unchecked, the camera won't zoom in on a beat hit.

checkbox.name: Score Text Zoom on Hit
checkbox.desc: If unchecked, disables the Score text zooming\neverytime you hit a note.

number.name: Health Bar Transparency
number.desc: How much transparent should the health bar and icons be.

checkbox.name: Combo Stacking
checkbox.desc: If unchecked, Ratings and Combo won't stack, saving on System Memory and making them easier to read

checkbox.name: Laggy Text
checkbox.desc: Uncheck this if you don't want that warning text\n telling you to turn off shaders to appear.\n(It can be very annoying sometimes).

checkbox.name: FPS Counter
checkbox.desc: If unchecked, hides FPS Counter.

checkbox.name: Extra FPS info
checkbox.desc: If checked, shows the current state.

checkbox.name: Camera Movement
checkbox.desc: If checked, the game camera will move depending on the animation of a character.

checkbox.name: Window Size Changes
checkbox.desc: If checked, the game window will change its resolution to some specific songs.

checkbox.name: Controller Mode
checkbox.desc: Check this if you want to play with\na controller instead of using your Keyboard.

checkbox.name: DownScroll
checkbox.desc: If checked, notes go Down instead of Up, simple enough.

checkbox.name: Middlescroll
checkbox.desc: If checked, your notes get centered.

checkbox.name: Disable Mechanics
checkbox.desc: If checked, disables the mechanics (ONLY HARD MODE!!!)

checkbox.name: Enable Judgement Counter
checkbox.desc: If checked, a judgement counter will appear on the HUD, wooahh..

checkbox.name: Enable Lane Underlay
checkbox.desc: Enables a black underlay behind the notes\nfor better reading!\n(Similar to Funky Friday's Scroll Underlay or osu!mania's thing)

number.name: Lane Underlay Transparency
number.desc: Set the Lane Underlay Transparency (Lane Underlay must be enabled)

checkbox.name: Ghost Tapping
checkbox.desc: If checked, you won't get misses from pressing keys\nwhile there are no notes able to be hit.

checkbox.name: Opponent Notes
checkbox.desc: If unchecked, opponent notes get hidden.

checkbox.name: Disable Reset Button
checkbox.desc: If checked, pressing Reset won't do anything.

number.name: Safe Frames
number.desc: Changes how many frames you have for\nhitting a note earlier or late.
